'''Chirr't Ferr''' was a [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] war hero who, according to [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] legend, helped lead the Jenet [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Great Conquest]], a conflict in which the Jenet took control of the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garban]] from the [[danchaf]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] goblins who had previously held domain there.<ref name="COTG ">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
